script.description: Original script with scenes, script points and subscenes. All continuity checks run automatically, even without supplied issues or correction_focus.

output_count.description: Number of refined script variations to generate. Defaults to 3.

issues_found.description: Optional list of user-specified issues already known or identified in the script.

correction_focus.description: Optional subset of issue types to prioritize during refinement.

examples.script:
INT. OFFICE - DAY
JOHN (laughing happily)
I just lost everything.
EXT. BEACH - NIGHT
MARY (whispering)
Why did we move here so suddenly?

issues_found.description: John is laughing while stating he lost everything.

examples.script:
INT. WORKSHOP - DAY
1. MAYA, in a blue jacket, holds a brass key in her left hand beside the desk.
2. Close-up: Maya now wears a red jacket and holds a silver key in her right hand by the door.
3. The key vanishes; she opens the desk lock using it without returning to the desk.
